method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Historical generalization retained in the 1988 setting; not an assertion about all subsequent elections.
Drug Czar translated as national drug-policy coordinator; original institutional chronology retained and explained separately.
Seven administrations and timing of evidence retained as Bush's campaign defense; debate transcript corroborates the defense, not the truth of every underlying intelligence claim.
Original campain understood as campaign; source English unchanged.

revisions.source: People wonder what you mean by this. You emphasize that you're not talking about income tax increases.
revisions.zh: 人们不明白你这是什么意思。你强调，自己并不是在谈提高所得税。

revisions.source: Most Americans wonder if you hit your head the wrong way getting out of bed this morning.
revisions.zh: 大多数美国人怀疑，你今天早上起床时是不是把脑袋撞坏了。

revisions.source: This answer, after the 1984 debacle, really has observers scratching their heads.
revisions.zh: 经历1984年的惨败之后，这个回答实在让观察人士摸不着头脑。

revisions.source: A naked support of free trade is taking things a little too far for the Democratic Party right now.
revisions.zh: 眼下对民主党来说，如此毫无保留地支持自由贸易，有些过头了。

revisions.source: In general, your party supports liberalized trade -- unless you are really trying to push yourself over the top in a couple of states.
revisions.zh: 总体而言，你的党支持贸易自由化——除非你确实想靠这个议题，在几个州争取足以获胜的额外支持。

revisions.source: You quickly specify that using the term “rights of the unborn” does not mean that you are pro-life, but your remark is still damaging.
revisions.zh: 你很快说明，使用“未出生者的权利”这个说法，不代表你反对堕胎，但这番话仍然造成了伤害。

revisions.source: Some supporters are disappointed by this statement.
revisions.zh: 一些支持者对这番话感到失望。

revisions.source: Liberals sense a bit of compromise in this response, when it comes to the issue of abortion.
revisions.zh: 在堕胎问题上，自由派从这个回答中感到了一丝妥协。

revisions.source: You quickly clarify that you yourself don't support the “right to choose”, but rather that it was a misstatement.
revisions.zh: 你很快澄清，自己并不支持“选择堕胎的权利”，刚才只是说错了话。

revisions.source: No Democrat has ever been elected President without winning Texas. Even so, liberal supporters are not pleased with this answer.
revisions.zh: 还没有哪个民主党人未赢下得克萨斯州却当选总统。即便如此，自由派支持者也不喜欢这个回答。

revisions.source: This is anathema to Southerners, Westerners, and many Republicans in general.
revisions.zh: 南方人、西部人以及许多共和党人，通常都无法接受这种立场。

revisions.source: This in line with your expected position, although it could be hurting you in some regions.
revisions.zh: 这符合人们预期的立场，不过可能会损害你在某些地区的支持。

revisions.source: This is a bit of a change from other Democrats, but it doesn't hurt to look strong on defense.
revisions.zh: 这与其他民主党人的立场有所不同，但展现国防上的强硬形象并无坏处。

revisions.source: This appears too much of a pander to Texans to go over well, when it runs against the normal principles of your party.
revisions.zh: 这看起来太像是在迎合得克萨斯州选民，而且违背了你党通常坚持的原则，因此难以获得好评。

revisions.source: This is a bold position, but it could definitely help some Texas Democrats make up their minds.
revisions.zh: 这个立场大胆，但肯定能帮助一些得克萨斯州民主党人作出决定。

revisions.source: Some environmentalist-influenced supporters disagree.
revisions.zh: 一些受环保主义影响的支持者不同意。

revisions.source: This is not the preferred answer for this situation.
revisions.zh: 在这种处境下，这不是最合适的回答。

revisions.source: Your comments make the nightly news, and are somewhat controversial in the farm states.
revisions.zh: 你的言论登上了晚间新闻，在农业州引起了一定争议。

revisions.source: This is not a popular answer in the farm states, and seems surprisingly glib on economic plight for a Democrat.
revisions.zh: 这个回答在农业州并不受欢迎，而且对一位民主党人来说，面对经济困境的态度轻率得令人意外。

revisions.source: You seem to be admitting that the Reagan Administration made a big mistake here, and that you either contributed or were not involved in the big choices.
revisions.zh: 你似乎承认，里根政府在这件事上犯了大错，而你要么参与其中，要么根本没有参与重大决策。

revisions.source: This is probably your best response. Take the attack to Bush.
revisions.zh: 这大概是你最好的回应。主动向布什发起攻击。

revisions.source: Good luck tomorrow!
revisions.zh: 祝你明天好运！

revisions.source: Dukakis attacks you relentlessly for refusing to debate, and it is not helping your position.
revisions.zh: 杜卡基斯不断攻击你拒绝辩论，这对你的处境毫无帮助。

revisions.source: Bush is hammering you on the decision not to debate, and it does play into a narrative that you're not up to the job.
revisions.zh: 布什正围绕你拒绝辩论的决定穷追猛打，这确实强化了你无法胜任总统的说法。

revisions.source: Unfortunately, Dukakis performed pretty well in these debates, and you seemed to miss a beat on a couple occassions.
revisions.zh: 遗憾的是，杜卡基斯在辩论中表现相当不错，而你有几次似乎慢了半拍。

revisions.source: Bush stumbled on a couple of occasions, and you did pretty well. Observers believe these debates will definitely help your case.
revisions.zh: 布什有几次失误，而你表现相当好。观察人士认为，这些辩论肯定有助于你争取支持。

revisions.source: Dukakis did not help himself with an awkward response on capital punishment, and observers agree that you seemed to win.
revisions.zh: 杜卡基斯对死刑问题的回答十分别扭，没能为自己加分，观察人士一致认为，你似乎赢了。

revisions.source: You stumbled badly in response to a question about capital punishment. Observers believe that Bush was the winner in these debates.
revisions.zh: 你回答死刑问题时严重失误。观察人士认为，布什赢得了这些辩论。

revisions.source: Your debates with Dukakis were largely inconclusive, and analysts agree that they are unlikely to affect the race.
revisions.zh: 你与杜卡基斯的辩论大体难分胜负，分析人士一致认为，它们不太可能影响选情。

revisions.source: Your debates with Bush were largely inconclusive, and analysts agree that they are unlikely to affect the race.
revisions.zh: 你与布什的辩论大体难分胜负，分析人士一致认为，它们不太可能影响选情。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the selection of Bob Dole as your running mate?
revisions.zh: 对于选择鲍勃·多尔作为竞选搭档，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: Would you support a free trade zone, encompassing Mexico, the U.S., and Canada?
revisions.zh: 你会支持一个涵盖墨西哥、美国和加拿大的自由贸易区吗？

revisions.source: What is your opinion on the recent Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty?
revisions.zh: 你如何看待最近签订的《中程核力量条约》？

revisions.source: What would you do as President to get the exploding crime rate in this country under control?
revisions.zh: 作为总统，你会采取什么措施，控制国内急剧上升的犯罪率？

revisions.source: Do you believe that free trade measures destroy more American jobs than they create?
revisions.zh: 你认为，自由贸易措施使美国失去的工作岗位，比创造的更多吗？

revisions.source: This would be a positive step forward for all three countries, including the United States.
revisions.zh: 这将使包括美国在内的三个国家都向正确方向迈进。

revisions.source: Bob Dole is going to do what Bob Dole does best, and we're proud to have him on our ticket.
revisions.zh: 鲍勃·多尔会做他最擅长的事，我们很自豪能与他组成竞选搭档。

revisions.source: We need to increase our vigilance in the War on Drugs, increase prison sentences, and allow capital punishment to be more broadly applied.
revisions.zh: 我们需要在禁毒战争中加强警惕，延长监禁刑期，并扩大死刑的适用范围。

revisions.source: We need to strengthen the power of the Drug Czar, and implement tough measures on repeat offenders. We also need programs to assist low-income families so that the children of today don't turn to crime in the future.
revisions.zh: 我们需要加强国家禁毒主管的权力，对惯犯采取严厉措施。同时还需要帮助低收入家庭的项目，避免今天的孩子将来走上犯罪道路。

revisions.source: We need more spending to counteract endemic poverty, and for drug treatment programs. We also need stricter gun control laws, and an end to capital punishment.
revisions.zh: 我们需要增加拨款，解决根深蒂固的贫困，并开展戒毒治疗项目。我们还需要更严格的枪支管制法，并废除死刑。

revisions.source: I'm predisposed to support this measure, but of course it depends on the specific negotiations that would play out.
revisions.zh: 我倾向于支持这项措施，不过当然还要看具体谈判结果。

revisions.source: I would oppose this measure without strong protections for the rights of American workers and employers.
revisions.zh: 如果没有对美国工人和雇主权利的有力保障，我就会反对这项措施。

revisions.source: I'm opposed to the expansion of foreign trade at the present time, when we are already dealing with a large trade deficit.
revisions.zh: 目前，我们已经面临巨额贸易逆差，我反对进一步扩大对外贸易。

revisions.source: I believe that free trade creates jobs. If I didn't believe that, I wouldn't support it.
revisions.zh: 我相信，自由贸易能够创造就业。如果不相信这一点，我就不会支持它。

revisions.source: Probably the effect is about equal, but it does allow American workers to focus on what they do best, which makes us more prosperous.
revisions.zh: 带来的得失大概相当，但它能让美国工人专注于自己最擅长的工作，使我们更加繁荣。

revisions.source: Free trade agreements definitely cost more American jobs than they create, further polarizing our society.
revisions.zh: 自由贸易协定肯定会使美国失去比它创造的更多工作岗位，让社会进一步分化。

revisions.source: This is a huge leap forward between the United States and Soviet Union, and I hope to oversee additional arms control measures during my time as President.
revisions.zh: 这标志着美国与苏联关系取得重大进展，我希望在总统任内继续推动军备控制措施。

revisions.source: This is a huge leap forward between the United States and Soviet Union.
revisions.zh: 这标志着美国与苏联关系取得重大进展。

revisions.source: The largest part of the party was advocating for Dole's selection, and they are pleased to see him on the ticket.
revisions.zh: 党内最大的一股力量一直主张选择多尔，如今看到他成为竞选搭档，他们很高兴。

revisions.source: Your position on capital punishment is a break from your record, and many liberals are displeased.
revisions.zh: 你的死刑立场偏离了自己以往的政治记录，许多自由派对此不满。

revisions.source: This answer is an unpleasant surprise for many potential supporters.
revisions.zh: 这个回答让许多潜在支持者感到意外，而且并不愉快。

revisions.source: This comes off like a laundry list of left-liberal demands, which many feel were repudiated in the 1984 election.
revisions.zh: 这听起来像是一长串左翼自由派的诉求，许多人认为，这些主张在1984年选举中已经遭到选民否定。

revisions.source: Many in the party are surprised by your protectionist tone.
revisions.zh: 党内许多人对你的贸易保护主义口吻感到意外。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the selection of Jack Kemp as your running mate?
revisions.zh: 对于选择杰克·肯普作为竞选搭档，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: Do you believe that voluntary prayer should be allowed in the nation's classrooms?
revisions.zh: 你认为，应允许全国学校的课堂开展自愿祈祷吗？

revisions.source: Do you have anything to say about your relationship with Manuel Noriega of Panama?
revisions.zh: 对于你与巴拿马的曼努埃尔·诺列加的关系，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: Seven Administrations have dealt with Manuel Noriega, dating back to the 1950s. As soon as his drug ties became known, it was the Reagan Administration that moved to indict him.
revisions.zh: 从20世纪50年代开始，已有七届政府与曼努埃尔·诺列加打过交道。他与毒品的联系一经查明，正是里根政府采取行动起诉了他。

revisions.source: This is the kind of specious attack that doesn't merit serious discussion in a national campaign. I trust that voters will be smart enough to focus on the real issues.
revisions.zh: 这类似是而非的攻击，不值得在全国竞选中认真讨论。我相信，选民足够明智，会把注意力放在真正的问题上。

revisions.source: I regret not taking active steps, as CIA Director, to limit our dealings with Manuel Noriega in the 1970s.
revisions.zh: 我后悔在20世纪70年代担任中央情报局局长时，没有采取积极措施，限制我们与曼努埃尔·诺列加的往来。

revisions.source: Jack Kemp is a towering figure within the Republican Party, and we're proud to have him on our ticket.
revisions.zh: 杰克·肯普是共和党内举足轻重的人物，我们很自豪能与他组成竞选搭档。

revisions.source: I support the right for local schools to decide whether to include a daily, voluntary prayer.
revisions.zh: 我支持地方学校自行决定，是否每天开展自愿祈祷。

revisions.source: I'm not touching this issue with a ten foot pole. If anyone asks, I will deflect deflect deflect.
revisions.zh: 我绝不碰这个问题。有人问起，我就转移话题，转移话题，再转移话题。

revisions.source: This is settled law. It is not appropriate to have public schools lead students in prayer, even if it is voluntary.
revisions.zh: 这个问题在法律上已有定论。公立学校带领学生祈祷并不合适，即使名义上是自愿的。

revisions.source: Better to finesse this issue, than to turn off a wing of the party like you just did.
revisions.zh: 最好巧妙处理这个问题，而不是像你刚才那样，得罪党内一整派人。

revisions.source: This is an embarrassing issue, but your best course is to minimize it and hope that it doesn't come up too much during the campaign.
revisions.zh: 这件事很尴尬，但最好的办法还是淡化它，希望竞选期间不会被频繁提起。

revisions.source: Jack Kemp is a fine choice for Vice President.
revisions.zh: 杰克·肯普是个很好的副总统人选。

revisions.source: This is the last thing that Democratic supporters expected to hear you say, and many are unpleased.
revisions.zh: 这是民主党支持者最不可能预料到你会说的话，许多人对此不满。

revisions.source: What message will you most emphasize as you accept the Democratic Party nomination?
revisions.zh: 接受民主党提名时，你将最着重强调什么信息？

revisions.source: To what extent will you make your performance as Governor of Massachusetts a centerpiece of your campaign?
revisions.zh: 你会在多大程度上将自己担任马萨诸塞州州长的政绩，作为竞选的核心？

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the selection of Lloyd Bentsen as your running mate?
revisions.zh: 对于选择劳埃德·本特森作为竞选搭档，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: To what extent will you campaign focus on your background as the child of Greek immigrants, and your rise through American society?
revisions.zh: 你的竞选将在多大程度上突出自己作为希腊移民子女、在美国社会中不断向上奋斗的经历？

revisions.source: What is your opinion on the selection of Dan Quayle as George Bush's running mate?
revisions.zh: 对于乔治·布什选择丹·奎尔作为竞选搭档，你怎么看？

revisions.source: How do you plan to attack the candidacy of George Bush, if at all?
revisions.zh: 你打算如何攻击总统候选人乔治·布什，还是根本不打算攻击？

revisions.source: The Bush campaign is attacking your opposition to the invasion of Grenada, and bombing of Libya. What is your response?
revisions.zh: 布什阵营正在攻击你反对入侵格林纳达和轰炸利比亚的立场。你如何回应？

revisions.source: The Bush campaign has repeatedly called you a “liberal” or “the liberal Governor”, and so on. Do you embrace the label of “liberal”?
revisions.zh: 布什阵营反复称你为“自由派”“自由派州长”等。你接受“自由派”这个标签吗？
